# What does a pound of wash and fold actually cost you?

> Free wash and fold pricing calculator for laundromats and laundry pickup-and-delivery routes: work out your real cost per pound from labour minutes, wash and dry cycles, supplies, delivery stops and overhead, then see the break-even price per pound and the margin at what you charge today. Runs entirely in your browser.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
